NEOW.description: no-modifier run → 3 options = 2 random positive relics + 1 random curse-cost relic. Positive pool: ArcaneScroll, BoomingConch, FishingRod, GoldenPearl, Kaleidoscope, LeadPaperweight, LostCoffer, MassiveScroll, NeowsTorment, NewLeaf, PhialHolster, PreciseScissors, ScrollBoxes, WingedBoots; plus one XOR extra pair rolled independently: LavaRock XOR SmallCapsule (skipped if the curse relic is LargeCapsule), NutritiousOyster XOR StoneHumidifier, NeowsTalisman XOR Pomander. Curse pool: CursedPearl, HeftyTablet, LargeCapsule, LeafyPoultice, NeowsBones, PrecariousShears, SilkenTress, SilverCrucible. Conflicts removed from the positive pool: CursedPearl−GoldenPearl, HeftyTablet−ArcaneScroll, LeafyPoultice−NewLeaf, PrecariousShears−PreciseScissors. Each relic also filtered by `IsAllowedAtNeow`. With run modifiers active, Neow instead offers each modifier's `GenerateNeowOption` in sequence. LIVE run-58 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-205108-aa378115.log): LargeCapsule listed in the curse pool — declined per policy; ScrollBoxes declined per repeated dilution advisory.
NEOW.live_notes: LIVE run-56: options = GoldenPearl(150g) / BoomingConch(elite draw2+1energy) / SilkenTress(lose gold, Glam enchant). Picked BoomingConch — engine value > gold. LIVE run-58 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-205108-aa378115.log): options = ScrollBoxes / GoldenPearl(150g) / LargeCapsule(2 relics + strike/defend dilution; curse-pool per references). TRASH_HEAP.description: DiveIn = lose 8 HP, gain a forgotten (removed-content) relic - reported pool DarkstonePeriapt / DreamCatcher / HandDrill / MawBank / TheBoot (mediocre). Grab = +100 Gold + a forgotten card - reported pool Caltrops / Distraction / Outmaneuver / Clash / DualWield / Entrench / HelloWorld / Rebound / Stack / RipAndTear. Run-43 at 44 HP before an elite corridor took GRAB (HP-economy doctrine: do not pay 8 HP for a mediocre relic pool; 100g sank at the tail shop fork). Caltrops (3 Thorns power, 1c) came from this pool and carried two fights.
TRASH_HEAP.name: Trash Heap

TRIAL.description: Accept/Reject then witness branches — MerchantGuilty: Regret curse + relic; MerchantInnocent: Shame curse + upgrade; NobleGuilty: heal; NobleInnocent: Regret + Gold; NondescriptGuilty: Doubt + reward; NondescriptInnocent: Doubt + transform.

VAKUU.description: BLOOD_SOAKED_ROSE → BloodSoakedRose relic: +1 max Energy each turn BUT pickup adds 1 **Enthralled** to deck — Enthralled = 2-cost Curse, Eternal, **must be played before other cards while in hand** (taxes 2e every appearance, blocks all other plays until paid; +1e/turn does not offset burst-line sabotage); SERE_TALON → pickup adds 2 random Curses + 3 Wish cards (curse-cost class); CHOICES_PARADOX → at start of turn 1 choose 1 of 5 random cards to add to hand; those cards gain Retain — **semantics: hand-add with Retain for that combat, new 5-option offer every combat T1, NOT a permanent deck add**. Archive decompile previously lacked Vakuu option handlers — this decode closes that gap.
VAKUU.name: Vakuu

Offered by Spiraling Whirlpool Observe on a basic Strike or Defend. Source: perplexity 2026-09-18 (sts2.untapped.gg/enchantments, spire-codex enchantments guide, sts2guides enchantment-guide).
VORTEX.name: Vortex / Spiral (enchant)

WATERLOGGED_SCRIPTORIUM.description: Unknown-room event. BloodyInk → +6 Max HP (free); TentacleQuill → pay 55g, enchant 1 card Steady; PricklySponge → pay 99g, enchant 2 cards Steady. Steady enchant = Retain (card stays in hand end of turn), permanent modifier. LIVE run-40: Bloody Ink taken at 79/86 — free HP against the #1 death class; 55/99g enchants would have gutted the Shop#1 sink.

WATERLOGGED_SCRIPTORIUM.pages.INITIAL.op.description: pay 99 Gold, Enchant Steady + card options.

WOOD_CARVINGS.description: Snake → Enchant Slither; Bird → transform into Peck; Torus → transform into ToricToughness. Slither enchant effect: the enchanted card's cost randomizes from 0 to 3 each time you draw it; cost-changing effects applied after the randomization can still raise the final cost above 3. Peck = 2 dmg ×3, Strike-tagged multi-hit that scales with Strength; ToricToughness = 2-cost 5 Block + regain that Block the next 2 times Block is cleared. Slither variance is anti-synergy with combo decks.
WOOD_CARVINGS.name: Wood Carvings

WOOD_CARVINGS.pages.INITIAL.options.TORU.description: transform into ToricToughness. Slither enchant effect: the enchanted card's cost randomizes from 0 to 3 each time you draw it
WOOD_CARVINGS.pages.INITIAL.options.TORU.name: Torus

ZEN_WEAVER.description: Unknown-room event, NO leave option — one of three must be taken. BreathingTechniques 50g → add 2 Enlightenment; EmotionalAwareness 125g → remove 1 card; ArachnidAcupuncture 250g → remove 2 (gated, absent below 250g). Removal prices 125/card — worse than shop removal 75g. LIVE run-40: paid 125g removal (1 Strike) over 2× Enlightenment (anti-synergy with 0-cost engine cards).
ZEN_WEAVER.name: Zen Weaver

ZEN_WEAVER.pages.INITIAL.options.ARACHNI.description: pay 250 Gold, **remove 2 cards**. Both removal options price at 125/card — worse than shop removal (75g)
ZEN_WEAVER.pages.INITIAL.options.ARACHNI.name: Arachnid Acupuncture
